UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

jobs.jd:
Your Mission:

We are looking for a Mechanical Systems Engineer to help us develop and integrate the Landing Gear System of our fully battery-electric aircraft (CS-23). Your work will span the full system development lifecycle, from system-level requirements, architecture and functional analysis through preliminary and detailed design, supplier involvement, prototype assembly support, ground & flight testing and certification.
